resources.string: You control start and stop recording.
Recordings are automatically started and stopped
Take a photo when a trigger occurs. Video recording stays manual.
Add your first trigger to capture the good stuff: a 5% descent above 50 km/h, or your next 500 W+ burst.
Choose a ride event or threshold to capture moments automatically. You can add several triggers.
Capture a moment whenever Karoo records a new lap.
Capture your hard efforts when power crosses your chosen wattage.
Capture fast stretches when speed crosses your chosen threshold.
Capture the summit of a climb on your active route.
Capture intense efforts when heart rate crosses your chosen threshold.

This trigger uses the selected automation mode during an active ride. Threshold triggers fire once on crossing, then rearm after you fall below the reset boundary. Missing sensor data cannot trigger a capture.
Ride boundaries only add highlights to a video already recording. They never start a video or take a photo. Pausing and resuming do not add boundary markers.

Choose a mode and add triggers for moments you want to capture during your ride.

**Automatic recording**

Your camera starts recording when a trigger is met. By default, it stops one minute after all triggers become inactive. A new trigger keeps it recording. You can change this delay or turn off automatic stopping in Auto recording settings.

You can always start a recording yourself or manually stop an automatic recording. Recordings you start yourself won’t stop automatically. Automatic recordings can also include highlights.

**Automatic highlights**

You start and stop recording yourself. Triggers add highlights so you can find your favourite moments later.

**Automatic photos**

Your camera takes a photo when a trigger is met, with at least two minutes between photos by default. You can change this interval in Auto photo settings. Photos are only taken when the camera is ready and isn’t recording video.

Keep your camera on and connected while riding.
Capture climbs at your chosen gradient and optional minimum speed.
Capture descents at your chosen gradient and optional minimum speed.
Add highlights at ride start and finish while a video is already recording.
